The '''KynachTech factory''' was a building on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kynachi]]. Originally used by [[KynachTech Industries]], it was taken over by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] when it stormed and seized the planet. It later became home to a [[KynachTech factory prison|prison]] under the Trade Federation's ownership of the facility.
